question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I was in Oman __around__ two months.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"since"** is used to refer to a point in the past until now or a point in time. (तब से)

 
 
• **Example: **She has been studying in this school since 2010.
 
 
 
• **"for" **is used to indicate a period of time. (के लिए)
 
 
• **Example: **He has been living in this city for five years.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the context of the sentence, "I was in Oman around two months," the correct word to use is **"for"** to indicate the duration of time spent in Oman.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **since** (तब से): Used to indicate a point in the past until now or a point in time.

 
 
• **Example:** She has been studying in this school since 2010.
 
 
 
• **into** (में): Used to indicate movement or action with the result that someone or something becomes enclosed or surrounded by something else.
 
 
• **Example:** He walked into the room and sat down.
 
 
 
• **from** (से): Used to indicate the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.
 
 
• **Example:** She traveled from New York to London.
